scope: Confirmed cached-index/private-Git-policy cleanliness defect; implementation choice, no new architecture or publication authority.
constraints: Same protected local Git policy; no user index/worktree mutation
Real staged/conflict changes must remain a refusal
Actual current-policy worktree/untracked and exact profile exceptions retained
HEAD/index races and unavailable reads fail closed

fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Scalable: Adequate. Linear checkout/index reads; bounded owned index, no service.
fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Maintainable: Strong. Standard read-tree plus explicit real staged guard; existing demonstrated fresh-index path.
fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Available: Adequate. Existing Git and private Temp only; failures remain refusals.
fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Reliable: Strong. Pins HEAD and checks actual index separately; rechecks both after observation.
fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Testable: Strong. Confirmed cache case, LF positive, staged negative and no-mutation assertions.
fresh_HEAD_index_and_actual_index_guard.Securable: Strong. Credential-blind local commands, private index, no source normalization or real index writes.

rebuild_actual_index_entries.Scalable: Adequate. Linear index serialization and worktree reads.
rebuild_actual_index_entries.Maintainable: Weak. Must preserve conflict, sparse and index-extension semantics through a second representation.
rebuild_actual_index_entries.Available: Adequate. Existing Git and private Temp only.
rebuild_actual_index_entries.Reliable: Adequate. Carries staged entries directly; additional index semantics need explicit handling.
rebuild_actual_index_entries.Testable: Adequate. Same failure case plus additional index-reconstruction controls.
rebuild_actual_index_entries.Securable: Adequate. Private output; more index input reconstruction to review.
